turns.content: We got a puppy three weeks ago. A golden retriever. I forgot how exhausting this stage is.
Puppy exhaustion is real — they're basically toddlers that can run faster. How is the sleep situation?
She slept through the night for the first time last night which felt like a miracle.
That first full night is genuinely cause for celebration. How's the training going?
Sit and stay are coming along. We're working on recall which is a disaster so far.
Recall takes time but it's worth prioritising early. High-value treats and keeping sessions short works best at this age.
She's enrolled in puppy classes starting next week. Mostly for socialisation I think.
Puppy classes are great for socialisation, and meeting other puppy owners for commiseration is an underrated benefit.
